svg.title: Four Pre-Flight Checks Before Contact or Record Processing
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-preflight-statutory-risk-routing; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Pre-Flight Checks Before Contact or Record Processing; subtitle: Each failed check routes to a named correction, not automatic case rejection.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: This is an ordered pass-or-repair decision chain. Apply the rules of the operating jurisdiction, communication method, record holder, and actual entity structure. A vendor certificate or an Arizona affiliation does not replace that analysis.; caption: Proceed only through the permitted service path: independent counsel, documented contact authority, valid record access, and verified identity and evidence provenance.; stages: label: Entity and compensation; value: Pass fixed or cost-plus scope; otherwise repair the agreement; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Check state-adopted Rule 5.4 restrictions, unauthorized practice rules, and attorney-advertising or runner statutes, including California Business and Professions Code sections 6151-6152 where applicable. An Arizona ABS requires actual court licensing and scope verification; do not extend its permissions across unrelated jurisdictions.; label: Contact authority; value: Pass documented channel authority; otherwise suppress the contact; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Apply 47 U.S.C. 227, 47 CFR 64.1200, applicable state calling rules, revocations, and do-not-call requirements. Use one-to-one seller-specific consent as an operating standard where consent is required; the FCC's 2023 one-to-one amendment was vacated in 2025 and is not a universal federal mandate.; label: Record access and security; value: Pass route-specific authority; otherwise correct scope and recipient; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Distinguish individual access under 45 CFR 164.524 from authorization under 164.508 and applicable 42 CFR Part 2 restrictions. Account for the Ciox limits on third-party directions and fees. Track the access rule's 30-day response period and permitted written extension; assess business-associate duties under 164.504(e) from the actual relationship.; label: Identity and causation exposure; value: Pass verified provenance; otherwise quarantine the affected work; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Check duplicate identity tokens, existing representation, source-page integrity, and inconsistent exposure dates. Counsel tracks MDL orders under 28 U.S.C. 1407 and expert-admissibility exposure under Federal Rule of Evidence 702. A general-causation dismissal can strand campaign spending even when intake files are complete.

text.title: Four Pre-Flight Checks Before Contact or Record Processing
text.tspan: Four Pre-Flight Checks Before Contact or Record

rect.title: label: Entity and compensation; value: Pass fixed or cost-plus scope; otherwise repair the agreement; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Check state-adopted Rule 5.4 restrictions, unauthorized practice rules, and attorney-advertising or runner statutes, including California Business and Professions Code sections 6151-6152 where applicable. An Arizona ABS requires actual court licensing and scope verification; do not extend its permissions across unrelated jurisdictions.

text.title: Check state-adopted Rule 5.4 restrictions, unauthorized practice rules, and attorney-advertising or runner statutes, including California Business and Professions Code sections 6151-6152 where applicable. An Arizona ABS requires actual court licensing and scope verification; do not extend its permissions across unrelated jurisdictions.

rect.title: label: Contact authority; value: Pass documented channel authority; otherwise suppress the contact; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Apply 47 U.S.C. 227, 47 CFR 64.1200, applicable state calling rules, revocations, and do-not-call requirements. Use one-to-one seller-specific consent as an operating standard where consent is required; the FCC's 2023 one-to-one amendment was vacated in 2025 and is not a universal federal mandate.

text.title: Apply 47 U.S.C. 227, 47 CFR 64.1200, applicable state calling rules, revocations, and do-not-call requirements. Use one-to-one seller-specific consent as an operating standard where consent is required; the FCC's 2023 one-to-one amendment was vacated in 2025 and is not a universal federal mandate.

rect.title: label: Record access and security; value: Pass route-specific authority; otherwise correct scope and recipient; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Distinguish individual access under 45 CFR 164.524 from authorization under 164.508 and applicable 42 CFR Part 2 restrictions. Account for the Ciox limits on third-party directions and fees. Track the access rule's 30-day response period and permitted written extension; assess business-associate duties under 164.504(e) from the actual relationship.

text.title: Distinguish individual access under 45 CFR 164.524 from authorization under 164.508 and applicable 42 CFR Part 2 restrictions. Account for the Ciox limits on third-party directions and fees. Track the access rule's 30-day response period and permitted written extension; assess business-associate duties under 164.504(e) from the actual relationship.

rect.title: label: Identity and causation exposure; value: Pass verified provenance; otherwise quarantine the affected work; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Check duplicate identity tokens, existing representation, source-page integrity, and inconsistent exposure dates. Counsel tracks MDL orders under 28 U.S.C. 1407 and expert-admissibility exposure under Federal Rule of Evidence 702. A general-causation dismissal can strand campaign spending even when intake files are complete.

text.title: Check duplicate identity tokens, existing representation, source-page integrity, and inconsistent exposure dates. Counsel tracks MDL orders under 28 U.S.C. 1407 and expert-admissibility exposure under Federal Rule of Evidence 702. A general-causation dismissal can strand campaign spending even when intake files are complete.

Assumptions: This is an ordered pass-or-repair decision chain. Apply the rules of the operating jurisdiction, communication method, record holder, and actual entity structure. A vendor certificate or an Arizona affiliation does not replace that analysis.
